title: The Palmer Method of Business Writing
author: Austin Norman Palmer (1859–1927)
place: New York, Chicago, Portland and Cedar Rapids: The A. N. Palmer Company
holder: Smithsonian Libraries; scanned for the Biodiversity Heritage Library, hosted by the Internet Archive

rights.statement: Public domain. The Library considers that this work is no longer under copyright protection.
rights.notes: US publication of 1915 (before 1931); the author died in 1927, so the work is also out of copyright under life + 70 everywhere. Don't use the name 'Palmer Method' as a product name (trademark); describe the hand as American business writing, 1915.
